key_insight: AAbAAC is a small manually annotated corpus built to improve information extraction for autoimmunity, especially named entity recognition of diseases, autoantibodies, targets, locations, and clinical signs.
clinical_relevance: Better autoimmunity text mining could help researchers organize biomedical literature more efficiently, but it is a research tool rather than a clinical decision aid.
method: Manually annotated 115 PubMed abstracts for autoimmune disease entities and relationships.
Evaluated several NER approaches on the corpus.
Fine-tuned NER models to test whether domain-specific training improved performance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports expected NER performance improvement after fine-tuning on AAbAAC, supporting the value of the annotated corpus for specialized extraction tasks.
watch_item: Because the dataset is small and limited to 115 abstracts, results may not generalize well beyond the autoimmunity literature it was curated from.
paper_title: AAbAAC: An Annotated Corpus for Autoimmunity Information Extraction
